name: Phylactery of the Cautious Maga
description: An invested device, a hollow wooden box with a silver lid holding an Arcane Connection to a safe place, that transports its wearer to safety.

name: Acquire the Connection
description: ReTe 15 effect of the Phylactery that transports a pinch of dirt or stone from around the magus into the Phylactery's empty compartment.

name: Flee to Safe Refuge
description: ReCo 44 effect transporting the wearer to the place designated by the Arcane Connection in the Phylactery; linked-triggered with Acquire the Connection.

name: Summoning the Distant Image
description: InIm 25 effect using an Arcane Connection to show images of a distant room, here appearing in the mirrored lid of the Phylactery.

name: Plaustrum Pertinax
description: A heavily warped covenant wagon turned Magic Thing via the Transformed Thing Virtue, stubborn and disobedient towards magi.

name: Immovable Object
description: Power of the Plaustrum Pertinax (ReHe 10) allowing the wagon to fix itself completely immobile in place.

name: Magic Thing
description: Virtue marking a creature as a magical object-being, possessed by the Plaustrum Pertinax.

name: Transformed Thing
description: Virtue (Realms of Power: Magic) granted to the wagon by a botched transportation spell, turning it into a Magic Thing.

name: Essential Virtue
description: Virtue from Warping held by the Plaustrum Pertinax.

name: Tough
description: Virtue possessed by the Plaustrum Pertinax.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Virtue possessed by the Plaustrum Pertinax.

name: Magical Monster
description: Flaw of the Plaustrum Pertinax marking it as a magical creature.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Minor Flaw; for the wagon its moving parts sometimes fuse, and it may arise from repeated transportation magic as loneliness when away from home.

name: Oversensitive
description: Flaw from Warping making the Plaustrum Pertinax oversensitive to orders from magi.

name: Personal Power
description: Magical Quality granting a creature a power; the Plaustrum Pertinax has it for Immovable Object.

name: Terram Resistance
description: Magical Quality/Ability giving resistance to Terram, held by the Plaustrum Pertinax.

name: Warping
description: Accumulated magical distortion from powerful mystical effects; instant transportation over 30th level inflicts Warping points leading to Flaws and Virtues.

name: Mercury's Winged Sandals
description: ReCo 20 spell letting the caster fly as fast as a running horse, controlled with Intelligence + Finesse rolls.

name: Woolen Steed of Araby
description: ReAn 20 spell imbuing a woolen rug or pelt with the power of flight, carrying the caster.

name: Vessel of the Clouds
description: ReHe 30 spell giving a small boat such as a coracle the power of flight with a Load of 50.

name: The Chariot of Zeus
description: MuCo(Au) 30 spell transforming the caster into a thunderbolt to travel instantly to any visible location.

name: Form of the Zephyr
description: MuCo(Au) 40 spell transforming the caster into a strong gale wind flying at 50 miles an hour.

name: Hermes' Portal
description: Powerful Mercurian Ritual allowing unlimited instantaneous travel between two points for a year.

name: Mercere's Portal
description: Permanent paired enchantments made by a secret House Mercere lab procedure acting like a Hermes' Portal; the network was torn down in the Schism War.

name: Gate of Countless Vistas
description: A device of instant transportation; in a saga seed a network of such Gates spreads across Mythic Europe.

name: The Leap of Homecoming
description: Rego Corpus spell of instant transportation that directly targets the individual and inflicts Warping.

name: Wizard's Communion
description: Spell allowing groups of magi to combine to cast spells such as the Hermes' Portal.

name: Cloak of Mist
description: Spell (ArM5 p.131) letting the caster seep through cracks like natural mist.

name: The Longest Step Made Short
description: Basic instant transportation effect of eighth magnitude, usable once per day.

name: Portage of the Eagles
description: Enchantment for instant transportation of goods over long distances.

name: The Mobile Infantry
description: Spell to shuffle soldiers across Mythic Europe.

name: House Mercere
description: The messenger House; guards the secret of Mercere's Portals, entrusted with the Order's banking in a saga seed, and supports the Silver Consensus.

name: House Verditius
description: Craft-magi House best skilled at enchantment, with a set pricing structure for enchanted items; supports the Silver Consensus.

name: House Tremere
description: House that might see the benefits of rapid transit for mass movement of troops.

name: House Guernicus
description: House supporting the Silver Consensus, preferring the mundane nobility not be molested.

name: House Jerbiton
description: House supporting the Silver Consensus to protect nobility and urban society.

name: House Criamon
description: House supporting the Silver Consensus to avoid magi having to govern mundanes.

name: House Bonisagus
description: House supporting the Silver Consensus; its Bonisagi could be stirred to jealousy by inventions.

name: House Tytalus
description: Militant House some of whose members support the Silver Consensus to avoid strengthening the Infernal.

name: House Flambeau
description: Militant House some of whose members support the Silver Consensus.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: House containing the Rusticani among its members.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, whose dynamics could be changed by magical technology and wealth creation.

name: Schism War
description: Historical conflict during which the Mercere's Portal network was torn down and wealth creation destabilized currencies.

name: Silver Consensus
description: Optional Tribunal ruling that no covenant may create more than two Mythic Pounds of silver per member per year, with further principles regulating magical wealth.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: The Order-wide Tribunal; in 1063 its 12th meeting confirmed rulings on sale of enchantments.

name: Quaesitores
description: Hermetic investigators who confiscate illicit wealth and regulate enchantment sales.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The law of the Order; magi may be selfish or amoral yet remain within it.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magic resistance which a magus must suppress to be affected by his own transport effect.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that effects need Penetration to breach.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A magical link to a person or place; enchantments are Arcane Connections to their creators.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's personal enchanted item; placing an effect in it allows Personal Range.

name: Laboratory Text
description: Written records of lab work allowing others to replicate devices more easily.

name: Invested Device
description: Enchanted item type into which effects are invested with vis.

name: Charged Item
description: Enchantment with a limited number of charges requiring no vis once a Lab Text exists.

name: Lesser Enchantment
description: Single-effect enchantment, e.g. the Hermetic Generans and Lancet of Good Health.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power measured in pawns, used for enchanting items.

name: The Gift
description: Supernatural talent for magic that engenders suspicion among mundanes.

name: Twilight
description: Final Twilight may embrace an innovator before passing on ideas.

name: Certamen
description: Magical duel that a rival might use to prevent dissemination of a device.

name: Wizard War
description: Sanctioned conflict between magi a rival might resort to.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Protective ritual that renders devices like the Instant Breach useless against covenants.

name: Covenant
description: Community of magi whose costs and provisioning can be reduced through magic.

name: Redcap
description: House Mercere messengers who would use the Gates of Countless Vistas.

name: Concierges
description: Specialist porters of merchant houses who work both sides of the Gates, suffering heavy warping.

name: Beguines
description: Women of wealthy background with lay religious vows who agitate against the Gates.

name: Magical Focus
description: Minor Magical Focus in Magical Transportation helps achieve instant transportation effects.

name: Motion Sickness
description: Flaw that may result from repeated transportation magic.

name: No Sense of Direction
description: Flaw that may result from repeated transportation magic.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Virtue that may arise from repeated transportation, including a sense of north.

name: Homing Instinct
description: Virtue from Realms of Power: Magic that may result from repeated transportation.

name: Monstrosity
description: (Form) Monstrosity Flaw developed by warped spice trees.

name: Boundless Wealth of the Oceans
description: CrAn 20 Ritual creating 3,000 pounds of identical pearls marked with the caster's sigil.

name: The Wealth of Croesus
description: CrTe 30 Ritual creating 13,000 silver pennies bearing the magus's sigil.

name: Potent Salts
description: Charged Item of crystals that turn seawater into salt.

name: Alchemical Separation of Brine
description: ReAq 4 effect of the Potent Salts converting salt water into pure salt.

name: The Garland of Prosperous Harvests
description: A pole with a wreath enchanted to grow plants rapidly and nourish orchards.

name: A Harvest of Figs
description: CrHe 40 effect bringing a plant from seed to maturity in a day.

name: Nourish the Displaced Vines
description: CrHe 19 effect permitting plants to grow well regardless of climate and soil.

name: The Instant Harvest
description: 35th-level spell that does the work of seven laborers.

name: The Elfin Baker
description: ReHe(Aq) 20 spell creating 12 dozen loaves of bread from ingredients.

name: The Elfin Brewer
description: Similar spell creating 12 dozen pints of ale.

name: Fill the Capacious Silo
description: CrHe 20 Ritual creating about twenty thousand bushels of grain.

name: Work of a Hundred Querns
description: ReHe 15 spell turning up to 10 bushels of grain into flour.

name: Hermes Mercatorius & Hermes Furis
description: Saga seed where the Order becomes the richest institution through banking by House Mercere.

name: Harco
description: Covenant where the Mercere Primus used confiscated wealth as capital.

name: Primus
description: Head of a House, e.g. Primus of Mercere at Harco and of Verditius.

name: Hermetic Generans
description: Lesser Enchantment (ReTe 15) of an iron disc producing rotary motion like one horsepower.

name: The Instant Breach
description: PeTe 15 Charged Item destroying a section of stone wall.

name: Breaking the Captain's Baton
description: Spell (Magi of Hermes) turning trained soldiers into an untrained group.

name: Dissolving the Wall of Shields
description: Spell (Houses of Hermes: Societates) turning trained soldiers into an untrained group.

name: The Lancet of Good Health
description: CrCo 25 scalpel giving +6 to Disease Recovery rolls.

name: Sever the Connection
description: PeVi 20 reducing an Arcane Connection's duration by three magnitudes.

name: Rusticani
description: Hedge wizards of House Ex Miscellanea using Craft Magic, also known as Mechanicals.

name: Craft Magic
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting the possessor enchant known magic into items.

name: Touched by (Realm)
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting crafters make wondrous items without vis.

name: Mathematici of Bologna
description: Learned magicians producing chartae swiftly.

name: Alchemy
description: Experimental philosophy using natural magic to produce reagents.

name: Greek Fire
description: Alchemical reagent mass-produced by the Byzantine Empire.

name: Byzantine Empire
description: Empire that mass-produced Greek Fire.

name: Inanis
description: Residue left behind when vis is imbued into an object.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability apprentices gain exposure in when making copies.

name: Finesse
description: Ability used in Intelligence + Finesse rolls for spells.

name: Concentration
description: Ability for maintaining effects and suppressing Parma.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability the Plaustrum Pertinax can use.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability of the Plaustrum Pertinax.

name: Athletics
description: Ability added when braced against an attack.

name: Awareness
description: Ability of the Plaustrum Pertinax.

name: Brawl
description: Ability of the Plaustrum Pertinax.

name: Living Language
description: Ability of the Plaustrum Pertinax.

name: Profession: Drover
description: Ability for damage rolls of the wagon.

name: Rego
description: Technique of control used in transportation and craft magic.

name: Creo
description: Technique of creation used in wealth spells.

name: Muto
description: Technique of transformation.

name: Perdo
description: Technique of destruction used in the Instant Breach.

name: Intellego
description: Technique of perception.

name: Corpus
description: Form of human bodies.

name: Terram
description: Form of earth and stone.

name: Herbam
description: Form of plants.

name: Animal
description: Form of animals.

name: Imaginem
description: Form of images.

name: Auram
description: Form of air.

name: Aquam
description: Form of water.

name: Vim
description: Form of magic.

name: Infernal
description: Realm the starving might turn toward.

name: Normandy
description: Region whose covenants crashed the economy of Flanders.

name: Flanders
description: Region whose economy crashed.

name: Genoa
description: City of warehouses and merchant consignments.

name: Paris
description: City of warehouses.

name: Nishapur
description: Persian city sourcing turquoise and malachite.

name: Badakhshan
description: Single source of lapis lazuli.

name: Persia
description: Source of turquoise, pearls and spices.

name: Serica
description: Distant source of silk.

name: Hind
description: Semi-mythical source of diamonds and spices.

name: Soqotra
description: Home of perfume-sorcerers.

name: Constantinople
description: City fallen in 1204.

name: Mediterranean Sea
description: Sea where 10 percent of ships are lost.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting.

name: Pliny the Elder
description: Classical authority on pearls and spices.

name: Hugh of Saint Victor
description: Author of a list of seven mechanical arts.

name: Plato
description: Philosopher dividing technologies into productive and acquisitive arts.

name: Hermes
description: God depicted as merchant and thief; Roman counterpart Mercury.

name: Croesus
description: Namesake of The Wealth of Croesus spell.

name: Ned Ludd
description: Name attached to Luddite manifestos.

name: Luddites
description: Movement destroying textile factories; proto-Luddites might harass covenants.

name: Artes Mechanicae
description: The mechanical arts, elevated in the 13th century.

name: Perfume-sorcerers of Soqotra
description: Sorcerers sent by spirits guarding incense trees.
